title: "Australian Business Economists Event on QE"
date: "2019-08-26"
categories: ["Economics", "Monetary Policy"]
---

Australian Business Economists hosted a Lunchtime Briefing on QE in Australia? What would it look like? with Ms Lyn Cobley, Chief Executive, Westpac Insitutional Bank, Dr Stephen Grenville AO, Non-resident Fellow, Lowy Institute, and myself.

Ross Gittins summarises the event in his write-up for the [SMH](https://www.smh.com.au/business/the-economy/how-strange-could-money-matters-get-if-the-worst-came-to-the-worst-20190823-p52k0r.html).

The text of my remarks can be found [here](https://stephenkirchner.substack.com/).
